settings.title: Omapop settings
settings.aiTooltip: Configure DeepSeek and other connections, plus prompt buttons
settings.desc.longPress: Hold the left mouse button for half a second to offer Paste, even without a selection or field detection. No Shift is needed in terminals.
settings.desc.requireTerminalShift: Hold Shift throughout selection in terminal windows, including plain shell prompts. Avoids stale popups from Herdr, tmux and other terminal apps that copy and clear their selection. Long press and the keyboard shortcut still work.
settings.desc.position: Auto places the bar above or below the pointer to leave your selection visible.
settings.desc.shortcut: Record a key combination to open the action bar. Clear it to disable.
settings.desc.excludedApps: Omapop stays hidden in these apps. Choose a running window to ignore its whole application.
settings.desc.searchEngine: Used by the built-in Search action. Choose 'other' to use the custom URL below.
settings.desc.searchUrl: Used when the engine is 'other'. Put *** where the selected text goes, e.g. https://example.com/search?q=***
settings.desc.showBarIcon: Keep Omapop in the bar for quick access to extensions and settings.
settings.desc.extensionDownloads: Allow installing reviewed directory extensions, including bundled Linux ports. Every installation asks for confirmation; new extensions start disabled.
settings.desc.directoryRefresh: Refresh the published listing weekly. This cannot change approved packages or versions.
settings.desc.dragThreshold: How far the pointer must move between press and release for the gesture to count as a drag selection.
settings.desc.hideDistance: The bar disappears once the pointer is this far from it.
settings.desc.maxSelectionKiB: Selections larger than this are ignored.
settings.desc.accessibilityProbe: Detect whether the focused field accepts text before offering Paste or actions that replace text. Browsers may need a restart.
settings.desc.assumeEditable: Offer editing actions when Omapop cannot tell whether a field accepts text.
settings.desc.terminalClasses: Window classes separated by commas. These apps paste with Ctrl+Shift+V and cannot cut.
settings.desc.commandKey: Choose the Linux key used by extensions written for the macOS Command key.
